title: Lower bound for an inverse-dimension power
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$ with $0<n$ and $k\le n$, \[ (1-\exp(-2))\frac{k}{n} \le 1-\left(1-\frac{2}{n}\right)^k, \] where the fractions are viewed as real numbers.
